_note: Vendored code facts, generated by scripts/sync-code-facts.mjs from each repo's code-facts.json. Do not hand-edit: re-run the sync script. Pages that opt in with a code-facts MDX comment are checked against this file by scripts/check-code-facts.mjs, and this file is checked against mnemom-api and mnemom-platform main by the scheduled 'Code facts' workflow.

api.compose.allow_unmapped_tools.false_w.summary: true when one scope setting allow_unmapped_tools false beats another setting it true (strictest wins).

api.compose.allow_unmapped_tools.unset_d.summary: Composer rule: the composed allow_unmapped_tools when no scope sets it, the platform layer included. Not a new agent's effective value: in prod the platform layer is platform_policies.alignment_defaults, read from the DB, and may set it. New agents stamp their own (api.new_agent.allow_unmapped_tools).

api.compose.grace_period_hours.min_acros.summary: true when the composed grace_period_hours is the smallest any scope sets.

api.compose.grace_period_hours.unset_omi.summary: Composer rule: true when no scope sets grace_period_hours, the platform layer included, and the composed card leaves it out (the gateway then applies its own fallback). Not a new agent's effective value: in prod the platform layer is platform_policies.alignment_defaults, read from the DB, and may set it. New agents stamp their own (api.new_agent.grace_period_hours).

api.new_agent.allow_unmapped_tools.summary: enforcement.allow_unmapped_tools stamped on a new agent's card (autonomy observe).

api.new_agent.autonomy_mode.summary: autonomy_mode stamped on a new agent's alignment card.

api.new_agent.grace_period_hours.summary: enforcement.grace_period_hours stamped on a new agent's card.

api.new_agent.integrity_mode.summary: integrity_mode stamped on a new agent's alignment card.

api.new_agent.protection_mode.summary: mode of the protection card a new agent is born with.

gateway.aip.boundary_proof.sampling_rate.summary: Fraction of boundary_violation checkpoints without card gaps that shouldProve sends to the prover. Fixed: proof_boundary_cap is not read.

gateway.policy.block.http_status.summary: HTTP status of a CLPI policy block (enforce refusal and fail-closed refusal, streaming and buffered). The block is marked by X-Policy-Verdict: fail.

gateway.policy.grace_period_hours.fallba.summary: Grace hours the gateway applies when the composed card sets no enforcement.grace_period_hours.

gateway.policy.reads_declared_tools.anth.summary: true when extractToolsFromRequest returns the tool a /anthropic/v1/messages request declares, so CLPI policy can evaluate it.

gateway.policy.reads_declared_tools.gemi.summary: true when extractToolsFromRequest returns the tool a /gemini generateContent request declares, so CLPI policy can evaluate it.

gateway.policy.reads_declared_tools.open.summary: true when extractToolsFromRequest returns the tool a /openai/v1/chat/completions request declares, so CLPI policy can evaluate it.
true when extractToolsFromRequest returns the tool a /openai/v1/responses request declares with GATEWAY_OPENAI_RESPONSES_COVERAGE unset (the code default), so CLPI policy can evaluate it.
The env var that turns on CLPI tool reading (and streamed AIP) for /openai/v1/responses. Per-cell values are pinned in mnemom/deploy cells/*.json.
true when extractToolsFromRequest returns the tool a /openai/v1/responses request declares with GATEWAY_OPENAI_RESPONSES_COVERAGE=true, so CLPI policy can evaluate it.

gateway.safe_house.canary_block.http_sta.summary: HTTP status of the Safe House canary hard-stop (sh_canary_triggered).
